description: A double row of avgas drums chocked against the wall, hand-pump clamped to the nearest one and a length of hose coiled over it. Chalk tallies climb the drums: fuel run out to strangers, paid or owed. Out here the sky is the only road, and this is the toll booth. A hand-lettered card wired to the pump reads: CASH ON THE SKID.
name: the avgas drums
